run_HHSearch_query: run an HHsearch query against protein databases using an A3M alignment string
create_HHSearch_instance: create an HHSearch wrapper instance with a binary path and database paths
get_template_hits: get parsed template hits from raw HHsearch HHR output string
review_HHSearch_init: review the HHSearch class init to validate database paths and set CPU limits
summarize_HHSearch_output_format: summarize the HHSearch input and output format properties returning a3m and hhr
